description: The booking link for a stay when you have no offer from get_rates (for example, get_rates could not be read): it re-checks the stay live and opens the hotel's booking page. When you have an offer, give its booking_url instead. Nothing is booked, held or paid here: the traveller books and pays on the hotel's page. Never call it a confirmed booking.

children.description: Number of children (under 18) in the party; leave out for none.

currency.description: With offer only: the total's currency, such as JPY.

hotel.description: The hotel id from search_hotels or resolve_hotel, or the hotel's website domain.

offer.description: Not needed: with an offer from get_rates, give its booking_url instead. An older client's offer id.

total.description: With offer only: the whole-stay total in minor units.

name: book_link
title: Get a booking link
